column1: # Reviewed path classes for CI profile selection (G003 CI revision Plan r2 §2.4; infra/ci/select-profile.sh).
# Format: class<TAB>kind<TAB>path. kind "file" matches exactly; kind "dir" is a prefix ending in "/". An exact
# file entry wins, otherwise the longest directory prefix. Classes: docs -> fast, agent -> fast (G049),
# runtime -> integration, foundation -> full; a path that matches nothing selects full (unknown-path). Malformed
# rows, duplicates, absolute paths or ".." fail closed. A project-subtree .claude/skills/ path (not under root
# .claude/ or .agents/) is foundation in select-profile.sh, ahead of the Markdown documentation rule (G049).
# G051 feature areas (Plan r3 §3.2-§3.3): classes area-web, area-core and area-intel select the affected profile
# for the area-ordinary files of an explicitly registered area. Kind "dir" only; the area name is the last path
# segment. Allowed roots: area-web web/app/(features)/<n>/, web/tests/browser/features/<n>/ and
# intelligence/src/<n>/ and intelligence/tests/<n>/ (<n> ^[a-z][a-z0-9]{0,31}$). A bad root or name, a file row,
# a duplicate, or any other row inside an area root exits 16. No web/features/ root exists until a reviewed
# guard extension. Registering an area is a foundation change; G051 registers none.
# docs: root *.md, docs/**/*.md and management/**/*.md are documentation.
# Automatic documentation-only push/MR pipelines are omitted by workflow.
# Exactly management/v0/SESSION-HANDOFFS.jsonl is non-executable session tracking, also omitted.
# management/v0/results/G###-scope-allowlist.txt is supervisor scope metadata (exact filename shape, no subdirectories).
# The selector and workflow omit scope-only automatic pipelines; scope enforcement itself remains required.
# Other non-Markdown controls retain foundation; mixed changes use remaining paths.
# runtime: application code (unit tests colocated with the code included).
# G009 (Plan r1 §2): the owned object-store adapter is foundation. Its covering checks are B-OBJ-* in the migrations
# suite, which the integration profile never runs.
# G011 (Plan r2 §10.3): the audit primitive package is foundation. Its covering checks are B-AUDIT-* in the migrations
# suite, which the integration profile never runs.
# Non-Markdown documentation and management controls remain foundation.
# Markdown instructions remain subject to review; explicit CI validates commands.
# G049: the three exact handoff instruction/metadata files are documentation (their automatic pipelines are
# omitted by workflow); other root agent paths select fast except the exact Vestive Claude alias below.
# The shared root Vestive skill and any unknown web agent configuration remain foundation.
# Fast metadata check; workflow still admits .gitignore-only pipelines.
# Required secret exclusions are checked by B-ENV-EXAMPLE in lint.
# The bundled, tracked development tooling (the optional Restruct SDLC skill).
# The migration CLI's own core dependencies (core/cmd/migrate imports observability, which imports config).
# G005: the tenancy model's real-PostgreSQL tests (B-TENANCY-IT) run in the migrations suite, which only full runs.
# G051 R3 widening (Plan r3 §3.2): security, first-paint, UI-primitive, shared-helper and contract paths select
# G014: the MCP connection setup page and its create and revoke routes.
# G018: the Group onboarding and shared Business Profile pages and their form routes.
# G019: the Organization members page and invitation pages and their form routes (Group members are under web/app/groups/).
# G058: the join pages and routes, the enrollment management page and route, and the enrollment HTTP adapter.
# G062: the platform signup service. Its covering checks are B-SIGNUP-* in the migrations suite, which the integration profile never runs.
# G062 (Plan r5 §2): the platform root signup pages and routes (their browser proof is identity:browser in the full profile).
# G020: the labels HTTP adapter, the Organization labels page and route and the label components (the Group label pages
# are under web/app/groups/). Their covering checks are B-LABELS-* in the migrations suite and identity:browser, full only.
# G069: the unaltered Vestive Brand kit source root (UI primitives, like web/components/ui/).
